title: UpKeep Board Header Deck
request: Oct 19 2026 12:02 ICT (relayed by UpKeep Develop): Max wants this-or-that decks to choose the Smart Upkeep branded header and footer for the four UpKeep agent boards (Members, Technicians, Tools & Equipment, Scheduling); Command Center left out, undecided. 12:06: header must include Emergency Alerts and a To-Do List like the dashboard folds. 12:07 decided for all four boards: pings and flags (Emergency Alerts), To-Do List and Documents live in the branded header.
example_data: Laptop browser mockups (1366 wide) of the Members board header: UP house mark, title, Emergency Alerts, To-Do List, Documents Center. Invented SAMPLE data. No real names, addresses or phones.
built_at_note: UpKeep board decks, Oct 19 2026 12:02-12:07 ICT requests
brands: Standard deck look (white, light beige accents, Khand/Hind)
Mockups: white/cream base, terracotta, lagoon and jungle accents, UP house mark, light only

pairs.ask: UpKeep Board Header: Block order, which header block should sit right under the title, Emergency Alerts or the To-Do List?

optionA.label: Alerts, To-Do, Documents
optionA.desc: Emergency Alerts first, then To-Do List, then Documents.
